existingDispositions.rationale: Current volition-to-self-endorsed-regulation mechanism is plausible but overlapping wording and pooled SDT correlations do not isolate independent causal change.
Competence and intrinsic interest are related, but feedback/choice manipulations affect multiple experiences rather than randomizing competence alone.
A clear goal supplies a comparison criterion, but Harkin experimentally promotes monitoring rather than identifying goal-specificity-to-monitoring intensity.
Retain current NON_MONOTONIC context dependence, but review cited evidence for perceived difficulty causing commitment rather than commitment moderating difficulty-to-performance.
Conflict can weaken one goal, strengthen prioritization of another, or affect enactment without changing intention; exact negative latent-intention effect is unresolved.
The current mechanism is already inaction-qualified. Preserve it, but explicit source findings distinguish action versus inaction regret and largely associative evidence.
A trait predisposition can affect state response, but scale-development provenance alone does not identify a manipulable independent trait-to-state causal contribution.
Moralized positions can accompany stronger action commitment, but reviewed work concerns attitude conviction and collective participation, not isolated goal attachment.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Intention is equivalent to action.
gapQuestions.rationale: Commitment and enactment differ; intention-behavior gap is not ontology equivalence.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Goal commitment and intention strength overlap.
gapQuestions.rationale: Goal attachment differs from action/time-specific intention; resolve aligned referents/items before an equivalence claim.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Goal performance proves goal commitment increased.
gapQuestions.rationale: Behavior outcome and measured attachment are not interchangeable.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Goal specification changes later self-monitoring.
gapQuestions.rationale: Existing REL-PSY-021 review reused; no second discovery edge.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A harder task proves a harder internal goal caused commitment.
gapQuestions.rationale: Task difficulty, perceived goal demand and commitment are different; no shortcut from performance.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Goal priority modifies intention-to-physical-activity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Experimental priority studies promising, but exact governed causal edge/behavior endpoint and intervention content require alignment; do not substitute priority→intention.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Goal conflict modifies intention-to-action.
gapQuestions.rationale: Conflicting experimental/observational results; no exact edge-target assertion retained.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Autonomous motivation equals intrinsic motivation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Self-endorsed valued action may not be enjoyable; do not merge.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Controlled motivation is simply negative autonomous motivation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Pressured and self-endorsed reasons can coexist; scale contrast not inverse causal force.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Bounded task-option choice can increase homework interest.
gapQuestions.rationale: Discovery of EA-CAND-PSY-LAYER-0007 only; not another proposition. High-school homework scope, null in other option tasks and missingness retained.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Choice→autonomy→intrinsic motivation pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Randomizing choices does not randomize autonomy. Patall Analysis 2 explicitly correlational; Reeve SEM cannot identify transmitted causal effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Positive competence feedback changes intrinsic interest.
gapQuestions.rationale: Reward reviews separate verbal feedback/tangible contingencies, but exact feedback identity, task and competence-independent effect scope need primary alignment.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Rewards universally destroy intrinsic motivation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Contingency, prior task interest, age and self-report versus behavioral measures differ; competing syntheses overlap.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Perceived option availability is identical to autonomy satisfaction.
gapQuestions.rationale: Option manipulation may change perceived choice without volition or intrinsic interest.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Relatedness satisfaction and belonging are synonymous.
gapQuestions.rationale: Overlapping experience but distinct referent/need formulation; consult F03, no new semantic equality.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Competence satisfaction and self-efficacy are equivalent.
gapQuestions.rationale: Current effectiveness and prospective capability differ; shared capable wording can cause measurement overlap.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Sleep restriction lowers approach motivation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Cognitive reward-effort willingness decreased but physical willingness did not; effort valuation endpoint differs from general approach motivation. Consult F10 without starting external Family work.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Sleep-loss state effects permanently alter reward sensitivity.
gapQuestions.rationale: No enduring trait evidence; do not infer PSY-F14 trait change.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Natural-environment exposure increases intrinsic motivation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Intrinsic aspirations in nature studies are goal contents/values, not enjoyment of a task; do not rename the endpoint.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Gamification increases autonomous or intrinsic motivation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Configurations and motivational outcome composites differ; higher-rigor subsplit effects less stable. No component efficacy or single generic gamification identity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cultural interdependence changes effects of personal choice.
gapQuestions.rationale: Choice review discusses culture/referent heterogeneity; country/ethnic group is not an exact moderator Driver or randomized culture.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Institutional autonomy-support rules increase autonomy need satisfaction.
gapQuestions.rationale: Rule occurrence/availability, experienced support and volition are separate; health correlational paths do not identify rule efficacy.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Social connection changes relatedness satisfaction.
gapQuestions.rationale: Earlier F03 exclusion/belonging review supplies constraints; no independent inverse contribution inferred.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Anticipated regret always increases intention.
gapQuestions.rationale: Action and inaction regret have opposite associations; current inaction mechanism must not be generalized.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Regret prompts alter anticipated regret and intention.
gapQuestions.rationale: Question salience and latent emotion are not equivalent; paired action/inaction wording and manipulation checks required.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Mastery versus performance instructions change intrinsic interest.
gapQuestions.rationale: Experimental synthesis indicates feedback and approach/avoidance contingency; exact goal orientation is not identical to general PSY-038/039.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Relative priority score is an executable causal weight.
gapQuestions.rationale: Rank/normalization describes priority only; no quantitative execution contract.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: External shock or routine demand changes goal priority/conflict.
gapQuestions.rationale: Plausible resource/opportunity mechanism but no exact natural-experiment endpoint extraction in this bounded search; occurrence alone not consequence.
